summary: Valion Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 6, 2026, disclosing an October 5 press release highlighting the expertise and goals of newly appointed board chair Thomas Jensen as they relate to the Company's future and advancement of Entolimod. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. The filing is a routine current report on a board leadership appointment, signed by Interim CEO Dean Zikria. No deal mechanics or regulatory clock apply; no risk-arb angle exists.
